nodes.name: distributed-queue
nodes.description: High throughput distributed event queue built with Go and Raft consensus.

readmeUpper.text:
# Distributed Queue

High throughput distributed event queue built with Go.

## Installation

```bash
go get github.com/alexdev/distributed-queue
```

## Usage

```go
queue.StartWorker(config)
```

![Architecture Diagram](https://example.com/arch.png)

## Features

- Zero loss persistence
- Consensus replication
- Built-in metrics observability

nodes.name: fast-router
nodes.description: Blazing fast HTTP router implemented with zero-allocation radix trees.

readmeUpper.text:
# Fast Router

Blazing fast HTTP router for high throughput APIs.

## Installation

Add fast-router to Cargo.toml dependencies.

## Usage Guide

```rust
let mut router = Router::new();
router.get("/api/v1", handler);
```

![Benchmark Chart](https://example.com/bench.png)

## Features

- Zero allocation routing
- Regex parameter matching

nodes.name: data-pipeline
nodes.description: Stream processing pipeline for real-time telemetry processing.

readmeUpper.text:
# Data Pipeline

Scalable real-time stream processing telemetry engine.

## Installation

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Usage

```python
from pipeline import StreamProcessor
processor = StreamProcessor()
```

![Architecture](https://example.com/diagram.png)

## Features

- Kafka & Redis streams integration
